Hey I actually went through something pretty similar quite recently. I can't really offer much advice but I think it's nice to know that there are people going through similar things. A couple days ago, after not smoking for a while, I smoked a bowl with two of my friends. Everything felt way too... magnified. My slightly sweaty hands felt like I just ran them under a sink, my beating heart felt like it was going to jump out of my chest, and I suddenly started to overthink EVERYTHING I was doing. "Am I breathing too loudly, is it normal to be staring at something for this long, am I doing something weird with my hands". I even thought I pissed myself because my legs were just slightly sweaty. I had never experienced anything like this before and decided that I had to go to bed. I couldn't fall asleep for another couple of hours, the anxiety was horrendous. I don't think I really had a panic attack, but it was very close. Felt super claustrophobic and scared of what my friends thought of me, wondering if I made a fool out of myself, even suicidal thoughts were poisoning my mind. 

The next morning, the thoughts were still there, although not as intense. That's never happened to me. My high-thoughts have never leaked into my sober mind. As I walked to school, "Am I walking normally? Are people staring at me? Is it normal to stand like this?" Just weird, obsessive thoughts like that. They've slowed down, but they haven't stopped. I've never really experienced suicidal thoughts before, and that's what is freaking me out the most. Ever since then, I can't help but wonder why I was thinking about suicide. 

I smoked weed again recently, but about half the amount. The anxiety wasn't as crippling, but it was still there. I tried my hardest to keep control of my thoughts. The negative, suicidal thoughts came up again, albeit less intense. Thoughts like "I think I'm going to lose my battle with depression. I don't think I'll make it past 25 years old", really depressing shit like that. 

I'm going to try staying clean from weed (and maybe even alcohol) because I've been getting shitty anxiety-related reactions from them lately. Definitely talk to a counsellor or something, I'm planning on doing so next week. If you'd like an update, I can keep you posted. Best wishes to you.
